SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS mode,
    NULLIF($2::text, '') AS lead_uuid_txt,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS selector,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS valor,
    NULLIF($5::text, '') AS last9,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS marca,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS estado,
    NULLIF($8::text, '')::date AS desde,
    NULLIF($9::text, '')::date AS hasta,
    LEAST(GREATEST($10::int, 25), 250) AS row_limit,
    GREATEST($11::int, 1) AS page_number,
    COALESCE($12::boolean, false) AS export_requested,
    10000::int AS export_limit
), p AS (
  SELECT params.*,
    ((page_number - 1) * row_limit)::int AS row_offset,
    CASE WHEN lead_uuid_txt ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' THEN lead_uuid_txt::uuid END AS lead_uuid,
    CASE WHEN selector = 'quicklink_id' AND valor ~ '^\d{1,9}$' THEN valor::int END AS valor_qlid,
    CASE WHEN selector = 'chatwoot_conv' AND valor ~ '^\d{1,9}$' THEN valor::int END AS valor_conv
  FROM params
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    l.id,
    l.quicklink_id,
    l.marca::text AS marca,
    l.nombre_cliente,
    l.telefono_1,
    l.telefono_2,
    COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', l.telefono_1) AS telefono_agente,
    l.modelo,
    l.agencia,
    l.ciudad,
    l.estado_ql,
    l.estado_agente::text AS estado_agente,
    l.fecha_venta,
    l.fecha_asignacion,
    l.created_at,
    l.sincronizado_at,
    l.reportado_ql,
    l.reportado_ql_at,
    c.id AS conv_id,
    c.estado::text AS estado_conv,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.plan_interes,
    c.ultima_respuesta_at,
    c.updated_at AS conv_updated_at,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS phone_digits
  FROM leads_quicklink l
  CROSS JOIN p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.id, c.estado, c.chatwoot_conv_id, c.plan_interes, c.ultima_respuesta_at, c.updated_at
    FROM conversaciones c
    WHERE c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
    ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  ) c ON true
  WHERE (p.lead_uuid IS NULL OR l.id = p.lead_uuid)
    AND (p.marca IS NULL OR l.marca::text = p.marca)
    AND (p.estado IS NULL OR l.estado_agente::text = p.estado)
    AND (p.desde IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.fecha_asignacion, l.created_at) >= p.desde)
    AND (p.hasta IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.fecha_asignacion, l.created_at) < p.hasta + 1)
    AND (
      p.lead_uuid IS NOT NULL
      OR p.selector IS NULL
      OR (p.selector = 'quicklink_id' AND l.quicklink_id = p.valor_qlid)
      OR (p.selector = 'telefono' AND (
            right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = p.last9
         OR right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_2, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = p.last9
         OR right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = p.last9))
      OR (p.selector = 'nombre' AND l.nombre_cliente ILIKE '%' || p.valor || '%')
      OR (p.selector = 'chatwoot_conv' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM conversaciones cc
            WHERE cc.chatwoot_conv_id = p.valor_conv
              AND (cc.lead_id = l.id OR cc.id = l.conversacion_id)))
    )
), limited AS (
  SELECT * FROM matched
  ORDER BY COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT row_limit FROM p)
  OFFSET (SELECT row_offset FROM p)
), export_rows AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM matched m
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE p.export_requested
  ORDER BY COALESCE(m.fecha_asignacion, m.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, m.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, m.id DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT export_limit FROM p)
), brand_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', marca, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, marca), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (SELECT COALESCE(marca, 'SIN_MARCA') AS marca, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1) s
), state_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', estado_agente, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, estado_agente), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (SELECT COALESCE(estado_agente, 'SIN_ESTADO') AS estado_agente, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1) s
), conv_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', label, 'count', n) ORDER BY label), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN conv_id IS NULL THEN 'Sin conversacion' ELSE 'Con conversacion' END AS label, COUNT(*)::int AS n
    FROM matched GROUP BY 1
  ) s
), age_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', bucket, 'count', n) ORDER BY ord), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (
    SELECT bucket, ord, COUNT(*)::int AS n
    FROM (
      SELECT CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '7 days' THEN '0-7 dias'
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '15 days' THEN '8-15 dias'
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '30 days' THEN '16-30 dias'
        ELSE '31+ dias'
      END AS bucket,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '7 days' THEN 1
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '15 days' THEN 2
        WHEN COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) >= now() - interval '30 days' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
      END AS ord
      FROM matched
    ) x
    GROUP BY bucket, ord
  ) s
), top_models AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', label, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, label), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(modelo, ''), 'SIN_MODELO') AS label, COUNT(*)::int AS n
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY n DESC, label
    LIMIT 8
  ) s
), top_agencies AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', label, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, label), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(agencia, ''), 'SIN_AGENCIA') AS label, COUNT(*)::int AS n
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY n DESC, label
    LIMIT 8
  ) s
), kpis AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total', COUNT(*)::int,
    'pendientes', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE')::int,
    'en_gestion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'EN_GESTION')::int,
    'confirmadas_ai', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'CONFIRMADA_AI')::int,
    'gestion_perdida', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'GESTION_PERDIDA')::int,
    'rezagados', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'REZAGADO')::int,
    'con_conversacion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conv_id IS NOT NULL)::int,
    'sin_conversacion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conv_id IS NULL)::int,
    'telefono_valido', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE length(phone_digits) BETWEEN 9 AND 15)::int,
    'telefono_invalido', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(length(phone_digits) BETWEEN 9 AND 15, false) IS FALSE)::int,
    'reportados_ql', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reportado_ql IS TRUE)::int,
    'no_reportados_ql', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(reportado_ql, false) IS FALSE)::int,
    'pendientes_30d', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE' AND COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at) < now() - interval '30 days')::int,
    'ultima_sync', MAX(sincronizado_at),
    'mas_antiguo', MIN(COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at)),
    'mas_reciente', MAX(COALESCE(fecha_asignacion, created_at))
  ) AS data
  FROM matched
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads_quicklink)::int AS base_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched)::int AS total,
  (SELECT page_number FROM p)::int AS page,
  (SELECT row_limit FROM p)::int AS page_size,
  (SELECT row_offset FROM p)::int AS offset,
  (SELECT export_limit FROM p)::int AS export_limit,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(li.*) ORDER BY COALESCE(li.fecha_asignacion, li.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, li.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, li.id DESC) FROM limited li), '[]'::jsonb) AS leads,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(er.*) ORDER BY COALESCE(er.fecha_asignacion, er.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, er.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, er.id DESC) FROM export_rows er), '[]'::jsonb) AS export_leads,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', (SELECT data FROM kpis),
    'by_brand', (SELECT rows FROM brand_stats),
    'by_state', (SELECT rows FROM state_stats),
    'by_conversation', (SELECT rows FROM conv_stats),
    'by_age', (SELECT rows FROM age_stats),
    'top_models', (SELECT rows FROM top_models),
    'top_agencies', (SELECT rows FROM top_agencies)
  ) AS dashboard;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS lead_id),
l AS (SELECT * FROM leads_quicklink WHERE id = (SELECT lead_id FROM p)),
phone9 AS (
  SELECT right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) AS p9 FROM l
),
conv AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM conversaciones c, l
  WHERE c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
  ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
),
convs_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM conversaciones c, l
  WHERE c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
),
cal AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM datos_calificacion d, conv
  WHERE d.conversation_id = conv.id
  ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
plan AS (
  SELECT pm.codigo_plan, pm.nombre_plan, pm.meses, pm.precio_usd
  FROM planes_marca pm, conv
  WHERE conv.plan_interes IS NOT NULL
    AND (pm.codigo_plan = conv.plan_interes OR pm.nombre_plan ILIKE conv.plan_interes)
  LIMIT 1
),
handoff AS (
  SELECT t.* FROM transferencias_humano t, l
  WHERE t.lead_id = l.id OR t.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv)
  ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
fups_pend AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', f.tipo_followup, 'scheduled_at', f.scheduled_at, 'status', f.status
  ) ORDER BY f.scheduled_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
  FROM scheduled_followups f, conv
  WHERE f.conversation_id = conv.id
    AND f.status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'PROCESSING')
),
fups_rec AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s.x ORDER BY s.ord DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (
    SELECT f.scheduled_at AS ord, jsonb_build_object(
      'tipo', f.tipo_followup, 'scheduled_at', f.scheduled_at, 'status', f.status,
      'processed_at', f.processed_at, 'error_msg', f.error_msg) AS x
    FROM scheduled_followups f, conv
    WHERE f.conversation_id = conv.id
    ORDER BY f.scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 5
  ) s
),
disp_rows AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM outbound_dispatches d
  CROSS JOIN phone9
  JOIN l ON d.lead_id = l.id
         OR right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(d.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = phone9.p9
  ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
disp AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'created_at', d.created_at, 'source', d.source, 'marca', d.marca,
    'intake_status', d.intake_status, 'delivery_status', d.delivery_status,
    'sent_at', d.sent_at, 'delivered_at', d.delivered_at, 'read_at', d.read_at,
    'failed_at', d.failed_at, 'error_code', d.error_code, 'error_message', d.error_message,
    'messages', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'role', m.role, 'meta_message_id', m.meta_message_id, 'status', m.meta_status,
        'error_code', m.error_code, 'error_message', m.error_message,
        'sent_at', m.sent_at, 'delivered_at', m.delivered_at,
        'read_at', m.read_at, 'failed_at', m.failed_at
      ) ORDER BY m.role), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM outbound_dispatch_messages m
      WHERE m.dispatch_id = d.id
    )
  ) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.failed_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS failed_count
  FROM disp_rows d
),
botones AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s.x ORDER BY s.ord DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (
    SELECT w.created_at AS ord, jsonb_build_object(
      'created_at', w.created_at, 'button_key', w.button_key, 'button_title', w.button_title,
      'status', w.status, 'reason', w.reason) AS x
    FROM whatsapp_interaction_events w
    CROSS JOIN phone9
    WHERE right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = phone9.p9
       OR w.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv)
    ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 6
  ) s
),
queue AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s.x ORDER BY s.ord DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (
    SELECT q.created_at AS ord, jsonb_build_object(
      'tipo_evento', q.tipo_evento, 'status', q.status, 'intentos', q.intentos,
      'error_msg', q.error_msg, 'created_at', q.created_at) AS x
    FROM sync_queue q, conv
    WHERE q.conversation_id = conv.id
    ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
  ) s
),
ultima_sync AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(s.*) AS row FROM sync_runs s ORDER BY s.run_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
contexto AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(cc.*) AS row FROM conversation_context cc, conv
  WHERE cc.chatwoot_conv_id = conv.chatwoot_conv_id LIMIT 1
),
eventos_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM eventos_conversacion e, conv
  WHERE e.conversacion_id = conv.id OR e.conversation_id = conv.id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT to_jsonb(l.*) FROM l) AS lead,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(conv.*) FROM conv) AS conv,
  (SELECT n FROM convs_total) AS convs_total,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(cal.*) FROM cal) AS calificacion,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(plan.*) FROM plan) AS plan,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(handoff.*) FROM handoff) AS handoff,
  (SELECT rows FROM fups_pend) AS followups_pendientes,
  (SELECT rows FROM fups_rec) AS followups_recientes,
  (SELECT rows FROM disp) AS dispatches,
  (SELECT failed_count FROM disp) AS dispatches_failed,
  (SELECT rows FROM botones) AS botones,
  (SELECT rows FROM queue) AS queue,
  (SELECT row FROM ultima_sync) AS ultima_sync,
  (SELECT row FROM contexto) AS contexto,
  (SELECT n FROM eventos_count) AS eventos_count,
  (SELECT chatwoot_conv_id FROM conv) AS probe_conv_id,
  (SELECT p9 FROM phone9) AS probe_phone;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS lead_id),
l AS (SELECT id, conversacion_id, telefono_1, created_at, sincronizado_at FROM leads_quicklink WHERE id = (SELECT lead_id FROM p)),
phone9 AS (
  SELECT right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) AS p9 FROM l
),
convs AS (
  SELECT c.id FROM conversaciones c, l
  WHERE c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
),
todo AS (
  SELECT e.created_at AS fecha, 'db' AS origen, 'EVENTO' AS clase, to_jsonb(e.*) AS datos
  FROM eventos_conversacion e
  WHERE e.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs)
     OR e.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.enviado_at, 'db', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', 'CONTACTO_' || i.numero_intento,
    'descripcion', left(COALESCE(i.mensaje_enviado, ''), 200))
  FROM intentos_contacto i
  WHERE i.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs) AND i.enviado_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.respondido_at, 'db', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', 'RESPUESTA_CLIENTE',
    'descripcion', 'Respuesta al intento ' || i.numero_intento)
  FROM intentos_contacto i
  WHERE i.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs) AND i.respondido_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(f.processed_at, f.scheduled_at), 'db', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', 'FOLLOWUP_' || COALESCE(f.status, 'SIN_ESTADO'),
    'descripcion', COALESCE(f.tipo_followup, '') ||
      CASE WHEN f.error_msg IS NOT NULL THEN ' - error: ' || left(f.error_msg, 120) ELSE '' END)
  FROM scheduled_followups f
  WHERE f.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.fecha, 'meta', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object('tipo', v.tipo, 'descripcion', v.descripcion)
  FROM outbound_dispatches d
  CROSS JOIN phone9
  JOIN l ON d.lead_id = l.id
         OR right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(d.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = phone9.p9
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (d.created_at,   'OUTBOUND_CREADO',  'Origen: ' || COALESCE(d.source, 'desconocido')),
    (d.sent_at,      'MENSAJE_ENVIADO',  NULL),
    (d.delivered_at, 'ENTREGADO',        NULL),
    (d.read_at,      'LEIDO',            NULL),
    (d.failed_at,    'FALLIDO',          trim(COALESCE(d.error_code, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(left(d.error_message, 160), '')))
  ) AS v(fecha, tipo, descripcion)
  WHERE v.fecha IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.created_at, 'db', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', 'TRANSFERENCIA_HUMANO',
    'descripcion', trim(COALESCE('Asesor: ' || NULLIF(t.asesor_nombre, ''), '') ||
      CASE WHEN t.razon_transferencia IS NOT NULL THEN ' - ' || left(t.razon_transferencia, 140) ELSE '' END))
  FROM transferencias_humano t, l
  WHERE t.lead_id = l.id OR t.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.created_at, 'meta', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object(
    'tipo', 'BOTON_WHATSAPP',
    'descripcion', trim(COALESCE(w.button_title, w.button_key, '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(w.status, '') ||
      CASE WHEN w.reason IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || w.reason || ')' ELSE '' END))
  FROM whatsapp_interaction_events w
  CROSS JOIN phone9
  WHERE right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 9) = phone9.p9
     OR w.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM convs)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.created_at, 'db', 'PLAIN', jsonb_build_object('tipo', 'LEAD_CREADO', 'descripcion', 'Alta en base local (sync QuickLink)')
  FROM l WHERE l.created_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.fecha DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS events
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM todo WHERE fecha IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fecha DESC LIMIT 200
) t;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($('Cargar Detalle Lead').first().json.probe_conv_id ? { conv_ids: [ $('Cargar Detalle Lead').first().json.probe_conv_id ] } : { phones: [ $('Cargar Detalle Lead').first().json.probe_phone || '' ] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'forbidden', message: $json.message || 'Acceso no autorizado' }) }}
